message:
Use KFM/LTER own urchin sizes; fix Macrocystis slope; cleanups

Urchin size pool (Emily review): KFM/LTER urchin size rows were in the pool
but lost their MPA/status metadata (the pool was merged only with the PISCO
site table), so KFM/LTER urchin biomass silently fell back to PISCO sizes --
a latent bug also present in Emily's V10. Backfill MPA/status from the MBON
geolocation table in 04 so all programs bootstrap from the combined PISCO+KFM
size pool matched by MPA/status/year/species (her review note #19). Density
effect sizes unchanged; biomass effect sizes shift slightly; +68 urchin-biomass
obs of coverage.

Macrocystis slope: 0.0925 (untraceable "May-Oct LTER") -> 0.08 (Reed et al.
2009). lnRR-invariant; only absolute kelp biomass changes (x0.865).

Cleanups: clarify Landsat annual-max/mean comment (behavior unchanged); add
data/mpa_take_regulations.csv documenting sheephead-MPA inclusion; clarify
holdfast comment; consolidate diagnostic CSVs under output/; correct stale
"KFM 0 obs" size-pool comments.
